title: Revised wedge demo sequence — 4 beats
summary: Old wow moments (context inheritance + as-of time travel) do not sell the wedge. Real sequence: (1) existing repo → graph shows where tokens are spent + autonomy level; (2) onboard foreign repo → progressive learning, value visible; (3) build feature in foreign repo → self-learning loop, multi-solution scoring, plateau detection with token economy; (4) bench scores on public programming benchmark as external verifiable proof. Beats are causally connected: 1 hooks, 2 shows moat, 3 is full loop, 4 is proof.
